what_this_is: Per-fund fee facts for the fixed-income shelf in docs/research/setting-the-equity-share.md, read from each fund's own Form 497K summary prospectus on www.sec.gov. Form N-PORT carries a fund's return and Form N-CEN carries its securities-lending income and waiver flags, but NEITHER carries the expense ratio, so this file exists. Every figure is the number printed in the fee table, not a rounded or restated one, and every row carries the accession number and the prospectus date so it can be re-read.
why_the_497k_and_not_the_485bpos: A 497K is the per-series summary prospectus, so its fee table belongs to one fund and one share class. A multi-fund 485BPOS prints many adjacent tables and reading the wrong row is a live risk. For the four Vanguard funds three same-day 497Ks exist, one per share class; the ETF Shares document was used in every case, identified by the ticker on its cover. That choice is load-bearing rather than cosmetic: VTIP's Admiral twin VTAPX charges 0.06% against the ETF's 0.03%.
waivers: NO FUND ON THIS SHELF HAS A FEE WAIVER, EXPENSE REIMBURSEMENT OR EXPENSE-LIMITATION AGREEMENT IN ITS FEE TABLE, and none has an acquired-fund-fees line. All sixteen documents were searched for 'waiv', 'recoup', 'recaptur', 'restat', 'contractually agreed', 'expense limitation' and 'until at least'; every hit was boilerplate in the performance section rather than a term of the fee table. Net therefore equals gross for every fund here, which is why the two columns agree and is a finding rather than an omission.
unitary_advisory_note: Every iShares fund carries footnote 1: 'Operating expenses paid by BFA under the Investment Advisory Agreement exclude acquired fund fees and expenses, if any.' The agreement is unitary, so the management fee is the whole ongoing charge except interest, taxes, portfolio transaction costs, distribution fees and extraordinary items. iShares tables also state that amounts are 'rounded to the nearest basis point, which in some cases may be 0.00'.
cross_check: Each of the six TIPS funds' prospectus total was checked against the independently prepared 'costs paid as a percentage of a $10,000 investment' line in its most recent annual shareholder report. All six agree exactly: SCHP 0.03 (period to 2025-12-31), VTIP 0.03 (2025-09-30), TIP 0.18 (2025-10-31), STIP 0.03 (2025-10-31), SPIP 0.12 (2025-06-30), LTPZ 0.20 (2025-06-30).
unreachable: Portfolio REAL YIELD for any of the six TIPS funds: not found. Neither the 497K nor the N-CSR publishes it. Section 9 of the study therefore prices the exposure from the Treasury's own constant-maturity real curve rather than from a fund's portfolio yield, and says so.

Effective duration or weighted average maturity of the fund's OWN portfolio: not found for VTIP, TIP, STIP, SPIP and LTPZ. Only SCHP's N-CSR publishes one. Where a maturity appears below for another fund it is the TARGET INDEX's, is labelled as such, and is not the fund's.
Acquired fund fees and expenses: not found; no fund on this shelf shows the line.
LTPZ 'Other Expenses' line: not found. Its fee table prints only Management Fees and Total.
Sponsor websites were not used for any figure. schwabassetmanagement.com returned HTTP 403 to an automated client on 2026-08-17 in earlier work and bot protection was not circumvented.
